brief.objective: A portable hardware sampler, sequencer and composer. Make bedroom producers want to pick one up and start a beat today.

selectedGoal.title: Pocket studio, one take
selectedGoal.description: A single continuous-feeling POV: hands find the device, tap, and a beat builds as the city moves past.

decisionEvidence.selectedReason: Puts the tactile pads and portability front and centre; strong sound-first hook.

referencesUsed.title: Making a beat from kitchen sounds in 60s
referencesUsed.why: Everyday-object sampling is an instant hook and shows the mic in use.

referencesUsed.title: Pocket studio on the train
referencesUsed.why: Shows portability with a relatable setting; POV framing.

referencesUsed.title: Teenage Engineering
referencesUsed.why: The brand's own look: grey chassis, orange pads, calculator-sized.

creative.reason: Sound-first hook lands in the first second; pads are the hero; pacing matches the POV reference.
